title: Portfolio Courtesy on Rental Property Service Contracts Returned-Payment Fees
content:
**Courtesy rule.** A Rental Property Service Contracts returned-payment fee carries a fixed-dollar portfolio courtesy set by the contract's recorded portfolio discount rate.

The contract's recorded portfolio discount rate is the rate recorded on its most recent annual premium charge for an annual-billed contract, and the rate recorded on the installment for the current term's first billing period for a monthly-billed contract.

| Contract's recorded portfolio discount rate | Portfolio courtesy |
|---|---|
| 0.10 or more | $10.00 |
| at least 0.05 but under 0.10 | $5.00 |
| otherwise | $0 |

**Records read.** The contract's billing frequency. For an annual-billed contract, the latest annual premium charge in its billing history and the portfolio discount rate it records; for a monthly-billed contract, the monthly installment whose billing period starts on the current term's start date and the portfolio discount rate it records.

| Billing frequency | Rate read from |
|---|---|
| annual | the most recent annual premium charge |
| monthly | the installment for the current term's first billing period |

**How the courtesy acts.** The courtesy is a fixed dollar amount taken off the fee, before any percentage reduction of the fee. The portfolio discount rate itself is never applied to the fee as a percentage.

## Boundaries

| Recorded rate | Courtesy |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | $0 |
| 0.05 | $5.00 |
| 0.10 | $10.00 |
